intuitiveness.evidence: The bounded studio journey works on desktop and touch phone: select the cabin, enter, drill through furniture and named shelf tiers, frame the selection, choose counts or an individual appearance, undo/redo, export and return. Prior independent checks established inherited parent/support lock explanations and disabled actions. Final phone checks again preserve all other records during snail-to-book replacement, restore exact undo/redo states, export the exact version-2 composition, and move keyboard focus to the politely announced Shelf 2 heading. All 20 center/off-center geometry picks now select the visible snail in both default and previously failing oblique views; a genuinely visible post still selects its bookcase. No recorded page/resource errors or phone horizontal overflow. Entry/exit focus and finer visual refinements are minor within this scope.

accuracy.evidence: Generation, admission, document transactions, snapshot transport and the new interior controller are Pascal. Independent worker counterexamples and retests establish fixed support poses, eight physically admitted furniture layouts, individual counts, cross-role neighbor preservation, Unicode labels, exact restoration and protected regional pruning. The measured bookcase, table and chair wrappers agree with the original GLB geometry and millimetre catalog; the local interior does not inherit the exterior scale multiplier. Final face-aware picking respects the near plane, skips culled faces and retains visibly double-sided geometry in an independent routed-archive fixture. Registered inputs cover the implementation, shared world/input/style contracts, actual GLBs, catalog provenance and composition tests. The documentation accurately limits this to one fixed studio profile and identifies approximate contact shading and the unfinished full-world requirements.

wowFactor.evidence: Independent room, shelf, ceramic close-up and first-person captures at 1440x960 and 390x844 show a coherent stylized interior with readable wood/plaster/cloth detail, glazed ceramic highlights, shaped plates, individually separated books and metre-scale furniture. The continuous floor replaces the distracting dashed geometric cracks with restrained filtered board/end joints; furniture and wall contact attenuation gives the arrangement visible grounding. Shared sage/mineral controls and progressive framing carry the same visual language from room to tiny ornament. These revisions close the earlier material-detail and floor-polish findings for the bounded cabin studio. This grade does not claim realistic full-scene dynamic shadows, a furnished whole world, seamless exterior access or completed cross-theme world quality.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: Persistent containment and support identities connect regional WFC placement to local furniture and individual contents. Exact shelf quotas, per-object appearance or book/ornament replacement, lock-aware preservation, local frame validation and reversible dependent cabin removal make that hierarchy practically useful. The player can reach a tiny supported object by either hierarchy or actual visible geometry while keeping neighboring items unchanged. The solution uses the pinned WFC capabilities without requiring an upstream library modification and retains the broader terrain-to-object specification as unfinished work.
